title: The Quiet Drop
author: F. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Beatrix Coldharbour, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
